description: This Java source file defines a class 'PolicyModifyCommandAdapter' which acts as an adapter for mapping 'PolicyModifyCommand' objects to and from 'Adaptable' instances within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes creation methods, a constructor, and a method to retrieve a type criterion as a string from a TopicPath object.

classes.name: PolicyModifyCommandAdapter
classes.description: Final class that functions as an adapter for PolicyModifyCommand objects, facilitating their mapping to and from Adaptable instances in the Ditto protocol framework.

methods.name: PolicyModifyCommandAdapter
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the adapter with mapping strategies and a signal mapper, requires a HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new PolicyModifyCommandAdapter instance, ensuring the HeaderTranslator is not null.

methods.name: getTypeCriterionAsString
methods.description: Returns a string representing the criterion name from a given TopicPath object.
